{{/* Recursive sidebar walker over Hugo's NATIVE page tree. Params: "pages" (Pages collection to render), "current" (the page being viewed). Mirrors the structure the old site.Data.nav walk produced (byte/pixel parity): -
divider for leaves carrying Params.nav_divider - section (not nav_leaf) with exactly one non-hidden child -> FLATTEN (lone child as flat link, no header) - section (not nav_leaf) with >1 children -> group header LINK (to the section's own _index overview) + recurse - leaf page OR nav_leaf section (e.g. a reference package) -> clickable link, NO recursion (the nav_leaf guard stops descent into the thousands of reference symbol pages) */}} {{/* Link styles are the .gd-nav-link / .gd-nav-group classes in main.css.tmpl, and the current page's pill keys off aria-current="page". One short class instead of the ~130-character utility list: a sidebar carries ~130 links, on every one of the thousands of pages. */}} {{ $current := .current }} {{/* listable-pages.html: no toc_hide pages, no folded API members, by weight. */}} {{ $items := partial "listable-pages.html" .pages }} {{ range $items }} {{ if .Params.nav_divider }}
{{ end }} {{ $active := or (eq $current.RelPermalink .RelPermalink) (.IsAncestor $current) }} {{ if and .IsSection (ne .Params.nav_leaf true) }} {{ $kids := partial "listable-pages.html" .Pages }} {{ if eq (len $kids) 1 }} {{/* single-child flatten: link points to the lone child, but the label stays the subsection title (.LinkTitle) to preserve byte/pixel parity with the old nav.json sidebar, which rendered the parent subsection's title here. */}} {{ $c := index $kids 0 }} {{ $ca := or (eq $current.RelPermalink $c.RelPermalink) ($c.IsAncestor $current) }} {{ .LinkTitle }} {{ else }} {{ $onIndex := eq $current.RelPermalink .RelPermalink }} {{/* The header of the section the current page sits in is marked aria-current="location" (the pill, "page", stays on the page itself): the reader sees which section they are in even with the section folded, and the mark is what sidebar-collapse.js does NOT treat as "you are already here" — clicking it still opens the section's overview. */}} {{ $ancestor := and (not $onIndex) (.IsAncestor $current) }} {{/* A foldable group (sidebar-collapse.js): the header row holds the overview link and the chevron that folds the panel below. The chevron is a sibling of the link, not inside it (a button in an anchor is invalid HTML), laid over the pill's right edge; pr-8 keeps the truncated title from running under it. data-nav-section names the group for sidebar-collapse.js; the panel id is what the chevron's aria-controls names, hashed so nested groups stay unique. */}} {{ $panelId := printf "nav-%s" (substr (md5 .RelPermalink) 0 10) }}
{{/* Same pill as a leaf when this is the current page (aria-current), so a selected section overview and a selected nested page read as the same state. mt-3/mb-2 keep sections close, as one list. They stay utilities here: the list's space-y (a utility too) would outrank them in a component. */}}
{{ .LinkTitle }}
{{/* Children of a group step in one level, so the page hierarchy reads at a glance: a section header and a nested group header otherwise look identical (same weight, same x). No guide line: the chevron and the fold already mark the group. Kept to 12px per level: the sidebar is 18rem and titles already truncate. */}}
{{ partial "sidebar-tree.html" (dict "pages" .Pages "current" $current) }}
{{ end }} {{ else }} {{ .LinkTitle }} {{ end }} {{ end }}
